paper_id: CodeEditor_ Learning to Edit Source Code with Pre-trained Models
title: CodeEditor: Learning to Edit Source Code with Pre-trained Models
motivation: 开发者70%代码编辑为重复性劳动，人工设计编辑模式繁琐易错
problem_framing: 将代码编辑建模为Seq2Seq任务，利用预训练模型学习编辑模式
key_insight: 用生成器将原始代码改写为缺陷版本，训练模型编辑缺陷版本而非填充mask，更接近真实编辑
method_signature: CodeGPT生成缺陷版本→预训练模型学习修复编辑→微调下游任务
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有代码填充任务（如MLM）源自NLP，未专门针对代码编辑设计
evidence_for_tight_frugality: code infilling tasks are derived from NLP
pre-training task specialized in code editing
thinking_moves: 指出现有预训练任务与目标任务不对齐的问题
将填充任务重新框架为编辑任务
利用语言模型生成训练数据避免人工标注
evidence_for_taste: code infilling tasks are derived from the natural language processing field
are not designed for automatic code editing
Our pre-training task aims to transform a previous program
requires a high-level understanding ability to locate inferior parts
closer to the real-world code editing task
